bio: The Pinn moved to this spot opposite Lee Jetty in 2023. Like the room, the menu is small but powerful, offering Malaysian-Chinese dishes, dumplings and even some Taiwanese and Indonesian titbits. Homemade mackerel fish balls are their speciality and you can order noodles on top to make it a complete meal. The food tends to be slightly on the sweet side to suit local tastebuds....
